settings.title: Settings

affects: How many days a new rental is charged: a pickup before the cutoff ends at the next morning’s deadline; a pickup at or after it, the morning after.
When a new rental’s car is due back. After the deadline it is a late return, and staff decide any charge, with a reason.
Rentals already agreed, and their phone extensions, keep the times they were agreed with.
before: Try a few pickup times near the new cutoff: a pickup may now be charged one day more or one day less.
Tell staff the new times before the next pickup.

affects: When insurance and revenue licence renewals, services (by date or by km, whichever comes first) and payroll start to show in Upcoming work.
Only when a reminder starts. No date, charge or car changes.
before: A shorter time leaves less time to renew. When insurance or a revenue licence has expired, staff are warned, and going ahead needs an authorised person and a reason.
A longer time shows reminders earlier, so Upcoming work gets longer.

affects: Only rentals set to “same level”: the litres missing at return × this price go on the bill, all for SNS. Staff can waive it with a reason.
By default fuel is not counted, so most rentals do not use this price.
Rentals already agreed keep the price from when they were agreed.
before: Check today’s pump price. Whole rupees only.
Tell staff the new price: they explain the fuel charge to the customer at return.

affects: Every agreement, bill and receipt printed from now on shows these details.
Printouts made before keep the details they were printed with.
before: Check the spelling: customers sign the agreement under this name.
All four details are needed before an agreement can be printed.

affects: Handovers from now on show this list.
Handovers already done keep the list they were ticked with.
before: Write one item a line, as staff see it in the car.
Handover needs at least one item on the list.
